A pleasant shift is easier when you know what to expect
Spare Blankets for Companion Animal Travel

When you travel with a pet on Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the process calm and practical. This guide covers when spare blankets may help, how they are handled, and what to check before you arrive. The aim is simple: keep the trip comfortable for the animal and straightforward for you.

Blankets can be useful for lining a carrier, softening a resting spot, or helping a pet settle after a busy check-in. A welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs before boarding, and the welcome team keeps the handoff smooth so the animal is not rushed. If your pet is sensitive to noise, a familiar blanket can make the cabin routine feel less sharp.

For small dogs, <<FACT F074>> Bring the usual travel items your pet already knows, since familiar texture and scent often help more than anything fancy. Keep the blanket clean, dry, and easy to fold so it does not get in the way during screening or boarding.

For larger dogs, health paperwork matters as much as comfort gear. <<FACT F081>> If you are carrying a blanket for a larger animal, make sure it fits the carrier or resting area without bunching or blocking airflow. A tidy setup helps the crew check the space quickly and keeps the journey moving.

It also helps to pack one extra cloth bag or cover for muddy or wet items, especially on route changes or long layovers. If the blanket has loose threads, strong odors, or heavy trim, swap it out before travel so the pet has a safer rest spot.

Aurelia Skyways treats companion travel as a shared responsibility, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to keep the details clear and workable. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you fly.
